name: gaps2-specialist-compounds
description: Specialist Compounds (Jol-Nar breakthrough, Thunder's Edge) — implemented by audit-gaps-2 (gate TI4_RULES_TECH / rulesGateTech). Card text: 'When you research technology using the Technology strategy card, you may exhaust a planet that has a technology specialty instead of spending resources; if you do, you must research a technology of that color.' (Jol-Nar synergy: green counts as yellow and vice versa.) pbd88@320 (Jol-Nar controls Meer, a WARFARE specialty): the pay-with-planet press is refused while the breakthrough is locked; after unlocking, Meer cannot pay for Gravity Drive (blue) but pays for Plasma Scoring (red) and is exhausted (original: not automated at all).
